parameters.query: select coalesce((select value::numeric from settings where key = 'MAX_DURATION_SEC' and value ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'), $1::numeric) as max_duration_sec

with lim as (
  select coalesce((select value::numeric from settings where key = 'MAX_JOB_MINUTES' and value ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'), $1::numeric) as max_job_minutes,
         coalesce((select value::numeric from settings where key = 'DAILY_BUDGET_USD' and value ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'), $2::numeric) as budget_usd,
         coalesce((select value::numeric from settings where key = 'MAX_CONCURRENT_JOBS' and value ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'), $3::numeric) as max_concurrent,
         coalesce((select value::numeric from settings where key = 'MAX_DURATION_SEC' and value ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'), $4::numeric) as max_duration_sec,
         coalesce((select value from settings where key = 'TURNSTILE_MODE' and value in ('enforce', 'monitor', 'off')), $5::text) as turnstile_mode
), running as (
  select id from jobs
  where status in ('queued', 'processing') and created_at > now() - ((select max_job_minutes from lim) * interval '1 minute')
)
select
  coalesce(sum(case when j.id not in (select id from running) then coalesce(j.total_cost_usd,
    (select sum((s->>'cost_usd')::numeric) from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(j.meta->'stages', '[]'::jsonb)) s)) end), 0) as spent_usd,
  coalesce(sum(case when j.id in (select id from running) then (j.meta->>'estimated_cost_usd')::numeric end), 0) as reserved_usd,
  (select count(*) from running) as running_jobs,
  (select budget_usd from lim) as budget_usd,
  (select max_concurrent from lim) as max_concurrent,
  (select max_duration_sec from lim) as max_duration_sec,
  (select max_job_minutes from lim) as max_job_minutes,
  (select turnstile_mode from lim) as turnstile_mode
from jobs j
where j.created_at > now() - interval '24 hours' or j.id in (select id from running)

with gc as (delete from turnstile_used where used_at < now() - interval '10 minutes') insert into turnstile_used (token_hash) values (encode(sha256(convert_to($1, 'utf8')), 'hex')) on conflict (token_hash) do nothing returning token_hash

insert into jobs (id, status, stages, source_id, source, source_language, preset, output_language, options, email, consent_152fz, meta)
values ($1, 'queued', $2::jsonb, $3, $4::jsonb, $5, $6, $7, array(select jsonb_array_elements_text($8::jsonb)), nullif($9, '-'), $10::boolean, $11::jsonb)
returning id
select j.id, j.status, j.stages, j.source, j.result, j.error, j.meta, j.preset, j.options, j.email, j.created_at, j.finished_at from (select 1) one left join jobs j on j.id = $1
select coalesce((select value::numeric from settings where key = 'MAX_DURATION_SEC' and value ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'), $1::numeric) as max_duration_sec
select j.id, j.status, j.result, j.source, j.source_id, j.preset, j.source_language, j.output_language, j.options, j.email, j.consent_152fz from (select 1) one left join jobs j on j.id = $1
select j.id, j.status, j.result from (select 1) one left join jobs j on j.id = $1
select j.id, j.source_id, j.source from (select 1) one left join jobs j on j.id = $1
select j.id, j.status, (f.job_id is not null) as rated from (select 1) one left join jobs j on j.id = $1 left join feedback f on f.job_id = j.id
insert into feedback (job_id, fits, easy, comment, via) values ($1, $2::int, $3::int, nullif($4, '-'), $5) on conflict (job_id) do nothing returning job_id
